title: Rhamondre Stevenson says Bears' defensive alignment helped with 48-yard TD

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rhamondre Stevenson says Bears' defensive alignment helped with 48-yard TD
sources.description: Patriots running back Rhamondre Stevenson made one of the most stunning plays of this NFL season when he turned a short pass at the end of the first half and ran for a 48-yard touchdown against the Bears.
